# Proposal Workspace

> Proposal tools for architecture firms. Level consultants' fees side by side, analyze the owner's RFP, and build the fee and schedule from it, all in one shared space. A lightweight web app: one person can start on their own, and the rest of the studio can join later.

Proposal Workspace is for architects and the people who put together their proposals. It reads the documents a pursuit involves (the owner's RFP and addenda, and the consultants' fee proposals), and turns them into a structured RFP review, a side-by-side comparison of consultant fees and scope, a fee worksheet and a project schedule. AI features are tuned to each firm through its "world view": what work it wants, its red flags, its expected fees and its track record. Accounts are invite-only during the beta; a demo with sample data needs no sign-up.
